layouts.name: Bombarral
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The operator identifies its full Circuito 1B course with the full southeast curved return and the smooth northeast corner; the angular northeast service alternative is excluded. Independent public nodes supply the trace; the archive image only identifies the named branches. The timing scalar is retained without stretching the course. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1102.9 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
